checkpoint_linearization.lock_scope: manager state mutation lock from layer capture through staged and current durable publication
checkpoint_linearization.included_commits: every commit completed before lock acquisition
checkpoint_linearization.competing_persists: serialized; an older captured stack cannot publish after a newer stack
checkpoint_linearization.recovery_and_relink: journal recovery and in-memory replacement share the same mutation lock

nested_finalization.identity_basis: session layer identity, not current stack top
nested_finalization.committed_descendants: may remain above a parent finalized by commit
nested_finalization.parent_commit: marks only the parent layer committed and preserves descendants
nested_finalization.parent_revoke: discards the parent layer and every descendant
nested_finalization.parent_merge: folds the parent and every descendant in stack order into the predecessor
nested_finalization.active_and_abandoned: cascade removal accounts for every live descendant and removes abandoned suffixes
nested_finalization.negative_pbft_offset: returns NegativePbftOffset; only a missing PBFT point falls back to solidity

isolation.manager_read_view: immutable durable root plus every committed non-abandoned overlay (logical HEAD); excludes active speculative overlays
isolation.manager_session_view: same immutable logical HEAD as manager_read_view; committed overlays remain visible before physical flush and active speculative overlays are excluded
isolation.durable_store_read: public physical durable-root read capability; excludes every overlay regardless of commit state
isolation.durable_store_mutation: rejected while any ordinary or pending session is active; checkpoint and flush root writes remain manager-locked
isolation.session_parent_capability: manager constructors create roots only at active depth zero; nested layers require the live top Session or PendingSession parent capability
isolation.checkpoint_read_view: materialized immutable committed state keyed by checkpoint identity
isolation.checkpoint_ancestry: each checkpoint retains identity, parent identity, block point, and state snapshot
